posts.title: Obsession
posts.review:
It shows how anything too much isn't good. The guy has feelings for her, she gets to know it that's how girls are we just get to know it. She even asks him if you do so, he flusters and says no. Thus he wishes that she gets obsessed in love with him. He gets the karma for the too much he demands for. 
   I have never felt loved by a guy so I don't know how crazy they can go in love. ( Crazy in good way) . I know about myself and so when I was watching the movie i could see the elements girls do when they are in love but because he wishes for obsession over just normal love she does it extremely. And the ending was cool, i mean the guy could have got a second chance too for the mistake he did. But yk life's unfair so he dies at the end, and the girl in the rage of obsession kills her two friends. And in that trauma the guy kills himself and the wish which turned as wrath in the life of 4 people gets released. And the girl who was possessed by the wish comes back to normal.
This was my insight from the first time i watched the movie but later on when i watched it again I had different perspective it felt like another movie but I do feel the way the storyline is presented here feels more like watching a vlog over a movie.
